title: Flashcards: Amphibians, families
intro: Flip each card about amphibians. Mark the ones you knew; the others come back sooner. Every answer shows its source.

cards.front: To which family does the Common Midwife Toad (Alytes obstetricans) belong?
cards.explain: The Common Midwife Toad belongs to the family painted frogs.

cards.front: To which family does the Tiger salamander (Ambystoma tigrinum) belong?
cards.explain: The Tiger salamander belongs to the family Ambystomatidae.

cards.front: To which family does the Chinese giant salamander (Andrias davidianus) belong?
cards.explain: The Chinese giant salamander belongs to the family Cryptobranchidae.

cards.front: To which family does the Panamanian golden frog (Atelopus zeteki) belong?
cards.explain: The Panamanian golden frog belongs to the family Bufonidae.

cards.front: To which family does the yellow-bellied toad (Bombina variegata) belong?
cards.explain: The yellow-bellied toad belongs to the family Bombinatoridae.

cards.front: To which family does the common toad (Bufo bufo) belong?
cards.explain: The common toad belongs to the family Bufonidae.

cards.front: To which family does the Japanese fire belly newt (Cynops pyrrhogaster) belong?
cards.explain: The Japanese fire belly newt belongs to the family Salamandridae.

cards.front: To which family does the natterjack toad (Epidalea calamita) belong?
cards.explain: The natterjack toad belongs to the family Bufonidae.

cards.front: To which family does the Bull Frog (Hoplobatrachus tigerinus) belong?
cards.explain: The Bull Frog belongs to the family Dicroglossidae.

cards.front: To which family does the golden toad (Incilius periglenes) belong?
cards.explain: The golden toad belongs to the family Bufonidae.

cards.front: To which family does the Northern Leopard Frog (Lithobates pipiens) belong?
cards.explain: The Northern Leopard Frog belongs to the family Ranidae.

cards.front: To which family does the Red-eyed Green Treefrog (Litoria chloris) belong?
cards.explain: The Red-eyed Green Treefrog belongs to the family Pelodryadidae.

cards.front: To which family does the Purple Frog (Nasikabatrachus sahyadrensis) belong?
cards.explain: The Purple Frog belongs to the family Nasikabatrachidae.

cards.front: To which family does the Common Spadefoot (Pelobates fuscus) belong?
cards.explain: The Common Spadefoot belongs to the family Pelobatidae.

cards.front: To which family does the Cane toad (Rhinella marina) belong?
cards.explain: The Cane toad belongs to the family Bufonidae.

cards.front: To which family does the Mexican burrowing toad (Rhinophrynus dorsalis) belong?
cards.explain: The Mexican burrowing toad belongs to the family Rhinophrynidae.
